final: WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS INTEGER)), 0) AS units FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, units, 1.0 * units / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_units), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS overall_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(units) AS combined_units, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > overall_share
